source_identity: Runtime/test/source for this release; tag identifies final publication commit. Byte equality of canonical math and shader source checked before measurement.

arms.A: v0.1.0 source at baseline_commit, baseline runtime
arms.C: v0.1.1 fixes, reuse runtime; FIR unchanged baseline

protocol.full_check: Every complete warmup and final output; repeated resident synthetic input; no per-dispatch unique work claim
protocol.summarization: Median of two independent runs per arm; all eight family results retained

profile.retention: COMPACT_PROFILE_ONLY; transient binaries, inputs, outputs and hashes removed

algorithmic_operations.FMA_convention: FMA=2 mathematical ops; RN32 oracle uses separately rounded mul/add, no fused FMA claim
algorithmic_operations.exclusions: Address/control/compare/bitcast/packing ops omitted. sqrt and sign requests shown separately for FP32; no instruction estimate.
algorithmic_operations.provenance: legacy_reference.py/vector_f32.py radix-2 FFT: 1024 butterflies/window, 4 mul + 6 add/sub
algorithmic_operations.scope: Canonical algorithm primitive arithmetic, input-dependent; same frozen count for every executor. No sum across datatypes.
